verdict.rationale: Sentry provides official SDKs to 'drop in' across platforms (sentry-docs-12, sentry-docs-29) and specifically supports AI-agent monitoring via SDK-based agent tracing (sentry-docs-13), plus OpenTelemetry-based ingestion for building custom instrumentation (sentry-docs-8, sentry-docs-25). This gives AI-native developers first-party SDK material to build against for both traditional and agentic use cases. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK integration experience, and deeper documentation specifically framed for AI-native build workflows beyond agent tracing marketing copy.
